title: Sweetener Detected
short_message: This product contains sweetening ingredients that are not sugar. Some may cause digestive effects if consumed in large amounts.
what_detected: BOTIA found: maltitol, sorbitol, xylitol, erythritol, isomalt, lactitol (sugar alcohols), or aspartame, sucralose, saccharin, acesulfame K (artificial sweeteners), or E codes E420, E421, E953, E965, E966, E967, E968, E950, E951, E954, E955.
why_it_matters: These ingredients provide sweetness without being sugar. Some people use them to reduce sugar intake. However, sugar alcohols (sorbitol, xylitol) can cause digestive discomfort—bloating, gas, or laxative effects—if consumed in excess. This is especially relevant if you eat multiple products with these ingredients daily.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot diagnose digestive sensitivity or tell you if this product is suitable for you. It only flags the presence of these sweeteners so you can make an informed choice.
source_note: Sugar alcohol effects documented in public health and nutrition literature. Individual tolerance varies.
